specialty_focus: (also referred to as Al-Mansour Engineering or Al-Mansour Medical Equipment in Iraq) specializes in the supply, installation, engineering, and maintenance of advanced medical diagnostic and imaging systems for hospitals and clinics. - Advanced Imaging Systems: Open MRI systems (such as Hitachi/Fujifilm models like Aperto Lucent and Airis Vento) and Helical/Spiral CT scanners (such as Philips Brilliance and Ingenuity slices).
